name: Empty Space Skipping with Orthogonal BSP Tree
aliases: Empty space skipping with texture hulls
Orthogonal BSP tree empty space skipping
definition: A technique to accelerate texture-based volume rendering by partitioning the volume into sub-volumes (boxes) based on voxel properties, reorganizing them into an orthogonal BSP tree for visibility sorting, and skipping sub-volumes that are fully transparent according to the transfer function.
summary: Empty Space Skipping with Orthogonal BSP Tree accelerates volume rendering by partitioning data into boxes and using an orthogonal BSP tree to skip transparent sub-volumes, optimizing lit rendering by separating surface from interior voxels.
